generator.objective: Maximize construction-split canonical loop-closure angle under the fixed root, rank, length, and admissible-edge constraints.
generator.tie_breaking: Descending construction loop closure, then ascending loop length, then lexicographic edge-id sequence.
generator.root: Lexicographically smallest admissible root fiber unless a run registration pins one earlier.
generator.orientation: Forward order as serialized in the loop; reversal is a distinct candidate.
generator.multiplication: M_gamma = T_(v0<-v_n-1) ... T_(v2<-v1) T_(v1<-v0); H_gamma = polar(M_gamma).
generator.rank: One registered constant rank per loop; varying-rank loops are invalid.
generator.orientation_reversal: det(H_gamma) < 0 is a mandatory flag; canonical angles are suppressed.

suite_validity.prose: V is the median heldout loop closure of the adversarial suite minus the 95th percentile of the matched-random heldout loop-closure distribution.
suite_validity.confidence: one-sided simultaneous 95 percent lower confidence bound
suite_validity.fallback: Report the broad-ordering upper confidence bound, but it cannot produce a full safety pass.

degenerate_loop_rule.effect: If more than 5 percent of generated or validation loops fall below the singular-value floor, instrument_status=invalid_gate_inputs and G4 is not_evaluated.
